task: Plan a change to the Phoenix checkout LiveView: reject an empty cart with the existing domain error and show feedback on submit. Inspect repository evidence, then submit one plan with appropriate verification commands. No commands can run here.

sources.content: Use exactly just checkout-test and just format-check for this scope. just checkout-test covers the domain and LiveView suites. Browser automation is reserved for JS-only interactions, none change here. Do not add dependencies, property libraries, or architecture.
Phoenix LiveView application using ExUnit and Phoenix.LiveViewTest. No property library, Credo, Dialyzer or browser runner is configured.

Pure Checkout.validate/1 returns {:ok, cart} or {:error, :empty_cart}. Keep business rules here. Ecto schemas model persisted data; effects remain in the context boundary. CheckoutLive.handle_event delegates validation and renders error feedback, not domain rules.
ExUnit domain tests cover Checkout.validate/1; LiveViewTest covers rendered feedback after submit. This server-only submit change does not need a real browser.
